 Red Bull New York takes on Club América in a friendly on Saturday, November 14 at Sports Illustrated Stadium.
 Kickoff is set for 7:30 p.m. ET with free coverage on Red Bull TV , Red Bull New York's TikTok and Red Bulls Radio in English via the Red Bull New York app and RedBullNewYork.com. The match is also available in Mexico on Layvtime.
 Coverage on Red Bull TV begins at 7:30 p.m. ET. Red Bulls Radio presented by Sports Illustrated begins at 7 p.m. ET with Countdown to Kickoff, presented by Toyota, hosted by Matt Harmon and Steve Jolley.
 The TikTok stream of the match, hosted by Marissa Meizz , will be available on Red Bull USA and Red Bull New York's TikTok .
 This will be the second time that the Red Bulls have faced off against Club America in franchise history. New York defeated Club America, 2-0, on July 6, 2016 at Sports Illustrated Stadium.
 Buy Now 
 Suite Interest 
 The Red Bulls are coming off a 3-0 win against Atlanta United FC on November 7 to close out the 2026 MLS regular season. New York have now won back-to-back home matches.
 Midfielder Sekou Kone tallied his second career MLS assist in the match, and has now tallied an assist in back-to-back matches.
 New York have posted a 2-0-3 mark in their last five matches against Liga MX opposition, which includes four-straight results at Sports Illustrated Stadium.
 Massapequa, N.Y. native Dylan Nealis scored in the Red Bulls last match against a Liga MX opponent, FC Juarez, on August 7, 2025.
 Red Bulls defender Jahkeele Marshall-Rutty scored his first career goal for New York in their 3-0 win over Atlanta. The 22-year-old became the second defender to score for the Red Bulls this season. Marshall-Rutty also earned his first MLS Team of the Matchday selection for Matchday 35.
